gap_notes: CORE cannot be scored. Neptune has no Ptolemy/Lilly elemental quality. Hand Horoscope Symbols Ch.4 1981 is one professional school, not consensus and not later Hand. Do not promote ultimate-reality or dissolution to CORE.

Calc already emits astrology.planet.neptune. The celestial_object schema requires function, themes, positive_expression, shadow, and four natal domains. Object withheld: filling those slots from Hand 1981 alone would make one school look like object SoT.

modern_structural is not a schema source_class. Parked source_class=professional / school=modern_professional like other Hand Ch.4 rows. runtime_semantic_candidate, do_not_compare_with, and classification_gap are not schema fields.
Do not model Neptune as dreams, intuition, or spirituality. Those are downstream expressions of dissolution of distinction, not the function.

Hand-specific outer operations (not CORE): Saturn creates distinction/ordinary reality; Uranus disrupts over-stabilized structure; Neptune dissolves distinction so the separated returns to a containing whole.

Same dissolution mechanism, two branches. Constructive: non-attachment, transcendence, mystical perception, imagination/ideal. Destructive: loss of distinction, idealization, illusion, confusion, victimhood, ego-defeat. No primitive rule strong Neptune = intuitive.

Maya is Neptune+Saturn combination, not Neptune-alone core. Artistic creativity is Neptune+Venus combination, not Neptune-alone. Abstract arts stays Neptune-alone and distinct from the Venus pair. No Layer 5 combo objects this pass.

Ideals ≠ illusion of perfection. Martyr ≠ victim (same sacrificial family, different pole). Mystery and confusion are related, not synonymous; kept together because Hand clusters them. Illusion is a shadow of weakened distinctions, not the whole function.

Nirvana is a school-specific spiritual register, not a universal Neptune. Non-attachment is not passivity; Hand lists destructive manifestations separately. Ego-denial/defeat is a bridge to psychological runtime, still school_specific.

Greene Outer Planets unread. Planets in Transit unread. Pluto has its own Hand Ch.4 claims ledger. Sun/Moon/Mercury Hand Ch.4 remain unextracted. Hand 1981 Para Research is dated contemporary-astrology; views later evolved.
